title: PSG-SB: single-merge collimation with full-secret block decoding

claims.statement: For every N>=2 and s in Z/NZ, with n=ceil(log2 N), the ONE PSG-SB algorithm and exact parameter rule of proof.md recover the full s from independent ideal source copies with unconditional probability at least1-2^-8>2/3. On EVERY branch including all retries, rejected or discarded copies, failed attempts, wrong numerical-label branches, partial inputs and either cutoff, its total charged sequential work T is O(2^((17/50)n)). This is its full uniform bit-length envelope for n>=2, with the explicit finite branch covering smaller n. Its exact envelope growth index is 1. All outside constants are absolute and independent of N,s and outcomes. This holds jointly with the other three resources and clean-only tolerance declaration for this same algorithm/configuration.

On EVERY branch including all retries, rejected or discarded copies, failed attempts, wrong numerical-label branches, partial inputs and either cutoff, its peak classical bits S_C is O(n^2). This is its full uniform bit-length envelope for n>=2, with the explicit finite branch covering smaller n. Its exact envelope growth index is 0. All outside constants are absolute and independent of N,s and outcomes. This holds jointly with the other three resources and clean-only tolerance declaration for this same algorithm/configuration.

For every N>=2 and s in Z/NZ, with n=ceil(log2 N), the ONE PSG-SB algorithm and exact parameter rule of proof.md recover the full s from independent ideal source copies with unconditional probability at least1-2^-8>2/3. On EVERY branch including all retries, rejected or discarded copies, failed attempts, wrong numerical-label branches, partial inputs and either cutoff, its total acquired original source copies Q including all rejections and discards is O(n^2). This is its full uniform bit-length envelope for n>=2, with the explicit finite branch covering smaller n. Its exact envelope growth index is 0. All outside constants are absolute and independent of N,s and outcomes. This holds jointly with the other three resources and clean-only tolerance declaration for this same algorithm/configuration.

For the same PSG-SB algorithm and complete parameter rule in proof.md, the proved malformed-sample fractional guarantee is epsilon(n)=0: all Q acquired source copies are independent ideal coset states. Under this promise, for every N>=2 and every s, unconditional full-secret recovery succeeds with probability at least 1-2^-8>2/3 jointly with all four every-branch resource bounds. No positive corruption tolerance is asserted, and this is not a proof that greater tolerance is impossible.

structured.error_model: Malformed fraction among acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires every copy to be an independent ideal coset state; no behavior is promised for malformed copies.
